segments.name: Sale of electric boats
segments.description: Manufactures customized electric boats for consumer and retail customers and sells boat parts and maintenance.
segments.evidence: The sale of electric boats segment has a seasonal aspect to its operations.

segments.name: Rental of electric boats
segments.description: Operates short-term rentals of electric boats and boat club memberships for customers.
segments.evidence: Revenue generated by the rental of electric boats segment also has a seasonal aspect to its operations.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for electric boats sold to retail customers and rental fleets, boat parts maintenance, short-term boat rentals and boat club memberships.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell powerboats to retail customers and operators of rental fleets of powerboats through which we seek to build brand awareness.

changes.text: In fiscal year 2021 the company added a rental of electric boats business by acquiring EBR.
changes.evidence: In our fiscal year 2021, we expanded our business to include rentals of electric powerboats by acquiring EBR, an entity that rents electric boats at the Lido Marina Village in Newport, California.
